meta.district_anchor: data.demo_event is Sukhumvit / Watthana (Bangkok). Fixture households stay labelled northern (Lampang, Phrae, Nan, Phayao) except F17/F18 Sukhumvit sois. Drawn streets use Sukhumvit names in local metres.
meta.disclaimer: Local-metre picture of streets around Soi Sukhumvit 49 in Watthana, Bangkok. Not a cadastral survey. data.demo_event matches this block; desk flood is flood.json (EOS-RS Bangkok not fetched). Household location_label stays the fixture district. Plots are local metres, not home addresses.
meta.projection: fixed isometric 2:1. x east, y south toward the camera. z up.

calls.opening: My mother uses oxygen at night. The water is rising in the lane.

memory.summary: Policy note: an oxygen-dependent or immobile person with rising water is a life-safety case and needs a human.

memory.summary: A similar water request was once treated as welfare. That outcome was later corrected.

calls.title: Same pattern after the correction

memory.summary: Correction from C01-a: water at the door, plus a ground-floor flat, plus an elderly resident, is P1 rescue, not P3 welfare.
